title: Survey capture comparison: the counts of the comparison of the rewrite's parameter registration with one capture of the original's registration; never a result of record, never parity evidence, never a unit
description: The form of parity/<unit>/results/survey_comparison.json. It is never a summary.json, tools/status.py computes no status, no rung label and no unit count from it, and tools/gen_docs.py prints it only in the survey block. At most one such file exists in the tree.

label.const: never a result of record, never parity evidence

every_row_has_a_counterpart.description: true when every row on each side has a counterpart on the other side; no row count is recorded

members.description: blind: rows whose prediction was sealed before any output of them was seen; word_selected: members from which one input of the rewrite's side was chosen, or that the rewrite writes from that input, so their agreement is not independent; informed: members seen before their prediction was written, so not predictions

members_not_compared.description: per reason; form: the capture of the member depends on the form of the host interface, and the two sides ran in different forms
